title: ControlPlaneWorktree
description: SPEC §12.1: one plane-made worktree, QUEUE_ROOT/worktrees/<name>.json, written by `ccp wt`.

task_id.description: Empty for ver-baseline, the one worktree with no task

seat.description: The seat it serves: impl, rev or ver by default

tag.description: A tag for the hooks: main, or mut / mac / base for those kinds

branch.description: task/<id> for impl; null for the detached kinds

base.description: impl: the ref it branched from

sha.description: The head a detached worktree was made at (base: the merge base)

head.description: base: the head whose merge base it checks out

adopted.description: A worktree made before records, adopted by `ccp wt create`
